hotspots.title: Vox’s Andalusian election leverage intensifies
hotspots.blurb: Vox's strong performance in Andalusia's regional elections has given it significant bargaining power, demanding policy concessions from the PP to support Juanma Moreno's government. The party insists on 'national priority' policies, including stricter immigration controls and social aid restrictions, while refusing to abstain in investiture votes.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to Vox's ability to dictate terms to the PP, reshaping Spain's political landscape and forcing compromises on contentious issues like immigration and welfare.

hotspots.title: La Libertad Avanza internal power struggles
hotspots.blurb: Argentina's ruling La Libertad Avanza party is embroiled in escalating internal conflicts, particularly between factions led by Santiago Caputo and the Menem cousins. The disputes involve allegations of fabricated social media accounts, judicial investigations into high-ranking officials, and public spats over government policies and leadership.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the high-stakes infighting within the ruling party, which threatens governance stability and public trust in President Javier Milei's administration.

hotspots.title: AfD’s poll surge and leadership ambitions
hotspots.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) continues to gain traction in polls, particularly in eastern states like Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia. The party's rising popularity is accompanied by internal power struggles, controversial proposals (e.g., 'remigration' policies), and debates over its extremist classification by domestic intelligence agencies.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the AfD's potential to reshape German politics, its polarizing rhetoric on immigration and nationalism, and the broader European implications of its electoral success.

hotspots.title: Meloni-Modi alliance reshapes Italy-India ties
hotspots.blurb: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi have deepened bilateral relations, focusing on strategic partnerships in defense, energy, and trade. Their collaboration includes the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) and efforts to elevate India-Italy ties to a 'special strategic partnership.'
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the geopolitical implications of the Italy-India alliance, its potential to counterbalance China's influence, and the symbolic significance of Meloni's outreach to a key Global South leader.
